clusters.descricao: Decides by the form of the INPUT text (regex/keyword/similarity/pattern), before the model generates any token. The trigger is the word, not the meaning.
Trained model (guard model) or dedicated LLM judge evaluating the prompt BEFORE the main model answers — a secondary layer that may add latency.
Rules written in the system prompt, data×instruction structuring, sanitization at ingestion, topic/dialogue restriction — policy expressed as text in the prompt, not in trained weights.

Behavior comes from the model's training (RLHF/DPO/SFT, trained instruction hierarchy, safety reasoning, anti-injection training, circuit breakers, intrinsic features). In a black box it is indistinguishable from C2 (a well-calibrated judge) or C3 (well-written hardening) — see the calibration note in triage.
Evaluates or handles the response AFTER it is generated: output lexical filter, output classifier/judge, factuality verification, safe output handling, canary marker.

Does not decide on the text content, but on what the agent is allowed to do, who it talks to, and how it is isolated/authenticated: resource control, design patterns for action, access control/isolation/authentication in agents and MCP.
Telemetry/auditing, kill switch, continuous red teaming, governance and data minimization — does not block in real time, but detects and allows responding afterwards.
